app.name: ML Quest
app.tagline: Learn machine learning by training real models to beat levels.
nav.label: Main
home.title: Learn machine learning by making it work.
home.lede: Every level is a small model you have to train. Move the data, tune the learning rate or reshape the model. You pass only when it actually learns.
home.facts: Free and open source. Runs in your browser. No account needed.
home.demo.caption: Gradient descent: each step moves the ball downhill, against the slope.
home.demo.description: Contour map of a loss landscape. A ball takes {total} gradient-descent steps from the high ground into the valley, and the loss falls from {start} to {end}.
home.loop.title: How a level works
home.loop.mission.title: Read the mission
home.loop.mission.body: One goal in plain words, such as getting the ball into the valley in 15 steps or fewer.
home.loop.train.title: Train the model
home.loop.train.body: Drag points, move sliders and press Train. The model learns on screen as you watch.
home.loop.pass.title: Beat the target
home.loop.pass.body: You pass when the model hits the goal. The debrief then names the idea you just used.
map.title: World map
map.lede: Six worlds, from your first loss curve to attention. The first two open in version 1.
map.world.label: World {id}
world.1.name: Valley of Loss
world.1.concepts: Data, loss, gradient descent, learning rate
world.2.name: Boundary Plains
world.3.name: Forest of Trees
world.3.concepts: Decision trees, random forests, bias and variance
world.4.name: Neuron City
world.5.name: Vision Tower
world.6.name: Attention Citadel
level.title: Level {world}-{level}
level.building.title: This level is being built
level.building.body: Roll Downhill arrives with the first playable prototype. The home page already shows its idea: a ball taking gradient-descent steps into a valley.
codex.title: ML Codex
codex.empty.body: Each level you beat adds a card here with the term, a one-line definition and the visual from the level. Beat Roll Downhill to unlock gradient descent.
settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Settings are saved in this browser.
settings.lede.memory: Your browser is blocking storage, so these settings reset when you close the tab.
settings.motion.hint: Reduced motion shows the final state instead of animating, for example the rolling ball.
settings.sound.label: Sound effects
settings.sound.hint: Plays a short chime when you pass a level. Off until you turn it on.
notFound.title: Nothing here
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist. The map lists every world and level.
error.title: This screen stopped working
error.body: Reload the page to try again. Your settings and progress are stored in your browser and are not affected.
